issue.title: Project task dependency links, project-inherited Blocked, and blocked-link consumption
issue.description: A project's (`^prj`) dependency links live in its note's `depends_on` frontmatter list. While a project has an open prerequisite or a future `scheduled` date, `^prj` and every open task in its note are Blocked `[?]`. No Blocked task keeps a Task Link under today's open Pomodoros: links are consumed (prerequisites promoted, link removed, emptied Pomodoro deleted). `bob task reconcile` auto-fixes existing notes such as `job_apply_to_databricks.md`, and the Ctrl+Shift+P and `create-project-note-from-task` keymaps write the new model.

COORDINATION (pending plan, not yet approved): epic plan "Pull an emptied project's ^prj task in as a successor link" (project_task_pull_in, proposed 2026-10-12) adds docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10 "Project pull-in": when a close gesture completes the last open task in a project note (same "no non-hidden open tasks, no open sub-projects" predicate as bob projects sync), the ^prj task is linked at the closed task's anchor, becomes Next, and loses #hide.
Overlap with this epic:
1. Its cli phase waits until bob-cli-6s.5 is closed and on origin/master. It then builds on 6s.5's §12.2 step-3 project-blocked verdict in successors.rs, so a pulled-in ^prj is never linked while Blocked and §13.5 consumption / 6s.7 hold.
2. It adds one §13.4 sentence: ADJ-11 governs dependency promotion; the §12.10 close-gesture pull-in is the one path that makes ^prj Next.
3. Its plugins phase edits nav only in 285-unblocked-notice.js. It reuses the cycler project helpers from 6s.11.
4. It never touches the MacBook until bob-cli-6s.12 closes (ADJ-13).
DISCOVERED ISSUE (from 6s.11): bob-navigation-hotkeys 285-unblocked-notice.js has no label for not_linked "project_member", so the raw key renders. It also renders still_blocked reason "project" as "waits on N more" instead of §12.6's "· blocked by project". The pull-in epic's plugins phase plans to fix both. If that plan is rejected, this gap needs its own follow-up.

FYI, no action needed in this phase: a pending plan (project pull-in, docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10, proposed 2026-10-12) will extend plan_successors after this phase lands. Its cli phase waits until bob-cli-6s.5 is closed and on origin/master.
It then reuses your §12.2 step-3 project-blocked verdict for a ^prj candidate ("does this ^prj's project still have reasons after the gesture"). Keeping that check callable for a given project note makes the follow-up smaller.
It also adds additive trigger / hide_removed fields to the unblocked[] / still_blocked[] rows you touch in capture/output.rs.

Rollout-order FYI (pending plan, project pull-in §12.10, which touches bob-cli, task-status-cycler and bob-navigation-hotkeys): its rollout phase will not touch the MacBook until this phase is closed (ADJ-13: bob before plugins).
If its phases land on master before you run the Mac steps, your just install + bob plugins sync carry them, and no extra step is needed. Optionally confirm that bob capture --dry-run JSON rows carry a trigger field.

Docs-sweep FYI (pending plan, project pull-in, proposed 2026-10-12): it adds docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10 "Project pull-in", §12.11 PP vectors, and one §13.4 sentence. That sentence says ADJ-11 governs dependency promotion, and that the §12.10 close-gesture pull-in is the one path that makes ^prj Next.
Please keep these through the sweep. In the project-deps-block-resident-tasks decision record, scope "promotion never raises a ^prj target into a lane" to dependency promotion.
The pending plan edits no glossary strand. Its optional decision record links yours if yours exists.

Docs-sweep keep: docs/task-dependencies.md now has §12.10 Project pull-in, §12.11 PP vectors, and a §13.4 sentence that ADJ-11 governs dependency promotion while the §12.10 close-gesture pull-in is the one path that makes ^prj Next.
